messages:
Maya (CEO): Quick note — all-hands this Friday 9:00am PT, 40m. Please skim agenda and drop any live Qs here or in the form. :memo:
Maya (CEO): Agenda:
- 8m: company pulse + hiring update
- 12m: product launch demo (live + failover walkthrough)
- 7m: policy update — data retention defaults + customer opt-ins
- 10m: roadmap highlights + live Q&A
- 3m: wrap + next steps
Maya (CEO): Slides + replay placeholder: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1redwood_allhands_feb (view-only)
Jamal (VP Product): We'll demo Hosted -> Dedicated fallback and the canary rollout flag. Adding sample prompts to the deck now.
Leila (Engineering Manager): Can we get a short run-through of smoke tests right after the demo? I'll prep a 1-slide checklist.
Kendall (Head Eng): Noted — infra will be on standby for burst tuning if the demo triggers capacity spikes. Tag me during the run.
Ivy (People Ops): RSVP deadline Thurs 2pm if you're coming to the office for the in-person viewing + lunch. Sign up: tinyurl.com/rw-allhands-feb
Eng-Deploy-bot: Canary pipeline scheduled on staging for Thurs 6pm. Will post status in #release-war-room.
Maya (CEO): Policy highlight — for internal dev orgs default retention moves to 90 days. Enterprise customers retain data per contract. Security & Legal signed off; comms plan coming.
Jamal (VP Product): If any customer-facing changes required, ping sales/support so we can coordinate messaging.
Leila (Engineering Manager): I'll add the post-launch smoke test owners to the doc and assign a quick rollback play if needed.
Ops-bot: Calendar invite sent. Recording + auto-captions enabled. Reminder set 30m prior.
Maya (CEO): If you can't attend live but want a prioritized question answered, put it in the Q&A form (short bullets): https://forms.gle/redwood-feb-allhands-qa
Jamal (VP Product): Draft runbook link (WIP): https://docs.google.com/document/d/redwood-launch-runbook — comments welcome.
Kendall (Head Eng): Action items from the session (will copy to tracker):
- Jamal: finalize rollout + fallback steps (Due: Thu COB)
- Kendall: implement burst metrics + tuning tickets (Due: Mon EOD)
- Leila: smoke test checklist + owners (Due: Fri EOD)
- Ivy: publish TL;DR + recording on wiki (Due: Mon)
Eng-Deploy-bot: Runbook snapshot saved to internal artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/runbooks/3609990000
Maya (CEO): Thanks team. We'll post the recording and a short TL;DR in the company digest. If you want your question anonymized, reply here with "anon". Closing thread in 72h with final action list. :sparkles:
